![Lab Grown Diamonds: HPHT vs. CVD Diamonds](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-e2d62260c327:4)
HPHT (High Pressure High Temperature) lab diamonds are `genuine diamonds grown in a laboratory by replicating the intense heat and pressure found deep within the Earth` . You can learn more about how they compare to other types by reading the [Rare Carat Lab Grown Guide](https://www.rarecarat.com/education/lab-grown-diamonds/lab-grown-diamonds-hpht-vs-cvd-rarecarat-com).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17784431984235645803&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.rarecarat.com/education/lab-grown-diamonds/lab-grown-diamonds-hpht-vs-cvd-rarecarat-com)

### How the HPHT Process Works

- **Seed and Carbon:** A small diamond seed is placed in a chamber with a pure carbon source like graphite.
- **Extreme Heat and Pressure:** Machines apply pressures over 700,000 PSI and temperatures around 1,500°C to 2,200°C.
- **Crystallization:** The carbon melts and builds layer by layer around the seed crystal over several days to weeks.[[1]](https://www.gia.edu/hpht-and-cvd-diamond-growth-processes)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15708973769468351350,catalogid:18230847369921746229,gpcid:6894364125195136489&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.linkedin.com/videos/kenkuang_can-you-believe-this-machine-can-grow-diamonds-activity-7375582110914502657-YZBm)[[4]](https://lgdusallc.com/blog-details/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds)

### Key Characteristics

- **Physical Identity:** They share the identical chemical composition, crystal structure, and hardness (10 on the Mohs scale) as mined diamonds.
- **Visual Appearance:** They are visually identical to natural diamonds and require specialized gemological tools to tell apart.
- **Distinguishing Traits:** Some HPHT stones may exhibit faint metallic inclusions or a subtle blue nuance due to trace elements like boron.[[1]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17784431984235645803&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.gia.edu/hpht-and-cvd-diamond-growth-processes)[[4]](https://www.whiteflash.com/diamond-education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds/)
